title: Nasher Museum of Art

services.name: Guided Tours
services.desc: The Nasher Museum conducts drop-in tours for the public most Sundays at 2 p.m. Capacity is limited. Please visit our event calendar for guided tour offerings and Thursdays at the Nasher programming. Organized groups must schedule a guided tour of current exhibitions or the Declaration of Independence copies during regular museum hours. Tours are led by Nasher gallery guides and last approximately 60 minutes. Groups of up to 30 people are welcome and will be divided into smaller groups of 15 people or fewer for the tour. services.name: Schedule a Class Visit
services.desc: We require faculty, staff, and student groups to schedule class and group visits - both self-guided and guided tours with Nasher staff - during regular museum hours via the links below. Admission is free for all. Submit a reservation inquiry online for group visits to the Declaration of Independence copies. Submit a reservation inquiry online for group visits to other Nasher exhibitions. Please feel free to take pictures or photos of artworks you see, without flash and for personal, non-commercial use
